lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the arch of ancient skies,
Where every shadow finds its place,
A legacy of courage lies,
Wrapped in the land's eternal grace.
[Pre-Chorus]
With every heartbeat, steady and deep,
The promises of old the people keep.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, steady and bold,
Write the story that the ages told,
One spirit bound in a common flame,
Moving forward in a sacred name.
[Verse]
Through winter frost and summer heat,
Through fields of gold and stone,
Through every storm and bitter defeat,
We stand together, never alone.
[Pre-Chorus]
With every heartbeat, steady and deep,
The promises of old the people keep.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, steady and bold,
Write the story that the ages told,
One spirit bound in a common flame,
Moving forward in a sacred name.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
From the dust of the humble ground,
To the heights where the glory is found.
[Chorus]
Rise like the tide, steady and bold,
Write the story that the ages told,
One spirit bound in a common flame,
Moving forward in a sacred name.
[Outro]
